dek: At its August earnings call, iFLYTEK acknowledged domestic accelerators trail Nvidia's H200 by up to 5x on long-context training. Instead of waiting for hardware, it is optimizing architecture, operators, memory and frameworks — proving the approach with Spark X2-Flash on Huawei Ascend 910B.
